newsitem.title: UK: London US stocks mixed to weaker on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: London US stocks mixed to weaker on profit taking.

text.p: U.S. shares traded here were mixed with an overall lower bias on Wednesday as investors took profits following the Dow's massive overnight gain, dealers said.

Barring shocks from first quarter GDP figures, due out at 1230 GMT, Wall Street stocks are seen as vulnerable to profit taking at the opening. GDP growth forecasts centre on 4.1 percent against 3.8 percent last time.
"We'll be a little weaker at the start although the figures shouldn't affect us much with much more important figures due tomorrow and Friday," said one dealer.
Labour market data and the U.S. NAPM are due tomorrow and Friday.
Oil group Chevron put on $3/8 to $68-1/2 with news of promising exploration tests off the coast of Angola still percolating through the market. Other oil share prices were mixed.
Hi-tech stocks led the decliners, dealers said. IBM shed $5/8 to $157-3/4, Digital fell $1/8 to $29-1/8 and Texas Instruments fell $1/4 to $88-1/2.
Intel traded $3/8 higher at $150-3/8, dealers said.
U.S. share trading in London on Thursday and Friday will be light with most of the European markets closed for the May Day holiday, they said.
